summary: Validated Master Report v5: (1) sections-catalog returns 10 groups including new 'sessions' group with 'Todas las sesiones (con ejercicios)' item; (2) SectionFlags accepts sessions=true and POST /generate produces a valid PDF; (3) PDF contains 'Sesiones de Entrenamiento', 'Plan Gráfico' and 'Conclusiones' headings (verified via pypdf text extraction); (4) Plan with 0 microcycles produces graphic_plan section without crashing (empty-state message); (5) No raw UUIDs leak into the diagnostic page (model UUID resolution + plan-name fallback works); (6) /preview with sessions=true returns a PNG. Frontend modal: subtitle exact match '8 estilos · 4 layouts · 24 secciones · sesiones detalladas · Plan Gráfico'; new groups 'Sesiones de entrenamiento' and 'Cierre' visible; checkboxes mr-section-sessions, mr-section-conclusions, mr-section-graphic_plan, mr-section-periodization_structure exist and toggle; mr-generate-btn enabled. Backend pytest 8/8 PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: master_report.py is now 1443 lines. Splitting into models / styles / html_builder / sections / routes is overdue (3rd iteration flagging this).
_capture_graphic_plan_on_demand still creates graphic_plan_shares documents on every report generation without TTL/cleanup (same as iter 55) — graphic_plan_shares collection will grow unbounded.

_PHASE_LABELS still only covers Spanish base IDs; English keys ('development', 'build', 'peak', 'taper', 'base') still fall back to Title-case English. Consistent with iter 55 note — extend the map for full Spanish labels.
PHASE_COLORS map in graphic_plan section duplicates the keys of _PHASE_LABELS — should be co-located with the label map to avoid drift.
Sessions section truncates exercises[:20] silently — if a real session has >20 exercises the user gets no indication. Consider adding a 'mostrando 20 de N' note.
seed_data_creation: none — used existing plans on test account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses /api/auth/login → JSON {token}. Login UI route is /auth (not /login). Master Report modal opens via [data-testid=header-master-report-btn]; Contenido tab is [data-testid=mr-tab-content] (not 'contenido'). All section checkboxes follow [data-testid=mr-section-{flag_id}] with snake_case IDs (graphic_plan, periodization_structure, etc.). For test@train.com the available plan(s) have 0 microcycles, so graphic_plan and sessions render their empty-state messages — this is expected and the PDF still generates successfully.
